title: Enum Types
description: Create and use a custom ENUM type for order statuses. Then query to find all orders with statuses that are NOT 'delivered' or 'cancelled' (i.e., active orders). Return columns: order_id, customer_name, total, status, order_date.
hints: Use the enum type as a column type in the orders table
Filter with WHERE status NOT IN ('delivered', 'cancelled')
